provenance.notes: A new repository fetched only the supplied pre-fix SHA. The patch applied cleanly with --index. Its reconstructed tree exactly matches the locally frozen claimed revision, whose sole parent is the supplied pre-fix SHA. Only claimed commit metadata/tree identity was read for this comparison; no later or accepted source was inspected.

acceptanceCriteria.details: Assigning a custom or named spinner with an interval updates ora.interval. A positive explicit constructor interval overrides the initial spinner interval. The focused submitted regression passes.

tests.details: AVA completed with 26 tests passed and 0 failed. TSD completed successfully.

regressions.details: Independent probes verified the default spinner interval (80), initial custom-spinner defaulting, constructor precedence (45 over 120), reassignment (210), preservation when a replacement spinner omits interval, and named-spinner default synchronization.

explainability.details: The setter resolves custom, default, platform, and named spinners into _spinner; synchronizing interval after resolution covers every replacement route. Constructor ordering then reapplies an explicit initial interval, explaining precedence preservation.

prReadiness.details: The two-file patch is localized, includes a focused behavioral regression, preserves adjacent defaults, passes runtime/type-definition tests and lint, and has exact provenance evidence.

build.details: This historical package publishes its plain CommonJS index.js and declaration file directly and defines no build script or compilation stage. Runtime loading and TSD cover the shipped artifacts.

lint.details: XO exited 0 under a Node 24 compatibility shim for removed util predicates, reporting only one pre-existing TODO warning. git diff --cached --check passed.

typecheck.details: The repository's TSD declaration suite exited 0. There is no separate TypeScript source compilation step.

limitations: Node.js 24.19.0 on Linux only; the historical Node matrix was not run.
The old XO dependency needs a compatibility shim on Node 24 because util.isDate and util.isRegExp were removed.
Spinner timing was validated as state/default behavior; no wall-clock animation timing benchmark was needed for the state synchronization acceptance.
